site.title: Vadym Tyemirov | Tools, Essays, Music, and Arts
site.description: Vadym Tyemirov's personal site: tools, essays, music, and arts published directly under tyemirov.net.

hero.title: Tools, essays, music, and arts.
hero.summary: Vadym Tyemirov is a product-minded engineering leader who bridges the gap between cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence and scalable enterprise infrastructure.
hero.detail: With a career spanning Meta, BlackRock, Shopify, and Morgan Stanley, he focuses on turning complex technical challenges into revenue-generating products. This domain collects the resulting essays, tools, and experiments in one place.

mprlab.blurb: Marco Polo Research Lab (MPR Lab) is an R&D studio dedicated to building products that bridge the gap between AI and infrastructure. We focus on turning complex technical challenges into revenue-generating systems.

projects.title: Minimum Sustainable Modern Civilization
projects.summary: Estimate the population floor needed to sustain a modern market economy under staffing, dependency, resilience, autarky, and demographic constraints.

projects.title: Decision Planes
projects.summary: Turn vague yes-or-no choices into explicit reasoning over confidence, stakes, expected value, uncertainty, and reversibility.

projects.title: The Vector of Liberty
projects.summary: Compare states by the friction they impose on concrete actions through taxes, permits, delays, and penalties, weighted against the kind of life you actually want to live.

projects.title: Timeline
projects.summary: Analyze ongoing processes and event thresholds to determine if a system is stable, ready for a decision, or drifting into failure.

items.title: Tyemirov Gallery
items.summary: Digital editions and virtual exhibits exploring the intersection of visual art and historical narrative.

items.title: The Human Act of Making Things Exist
items.summary: AI, Authorship, and the indomitable Will behind the human act of creation.

items.title: The Age of the Meta-Manager
items.summary: The shift from personal competence to systems orchestration as the primary scarcity in the age of AI.

items.title: The Wittgenstein Mirror
items.summary: Beyond the hype of 'Superintelligence' and the fear of 'AI Slop'—using the digital mirror to expand human agency.

items.title: Codex Fast and the Price of Intelligence on a Clock
items.summary: Examining how intelligence is priced when speed becomes the primary variable in model performance.
